title: The Skipped Memory Block
subject: OS
briefing: A memory allocator scans free blocks from the beginning and should reserve the first block large enough for a process.
symptom: A process is told no memory is available even though the first block can hold it.
hints: Try a request that fits only in the first block.
The allocator's scan starts at a particular index. Is that the first block?
An array's first element is at index zero.
